items.statement: Comply with the postmarketing safety reporting requirements that apply to the product according to its application type (device application, NDA or ANDA, or BLA), whether you are a combination product applicant or a constituent part applicant.
items.quote: If you are a combination product applicant or constituent part applicant, you must comply with the reporting requirements identified in paragraphs (b)(1), (b)(2), or (b)(3) of this section for your product based on its application type.
items.condition: combination product or constituent part applicant

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, submit the application-type-based postmarketing safety report unless a report for the same event has already been submitted under the constituent-part-based requirements that contains the required information, is required to be submitted in the same manner, and meets the applicable deadlines.
items.quote: If you are a combination product applicant, you are required to submit a report as specified in this paragraph unless you have already submitted a report in accordance with paragraph (c) of this section for the same event that: Includes the information required under the applicable regulations identified in this paragraph, is required to be submitted in the same manner under § 4.104, and meets the deadlines under the applicable regulations identified in this paragraph.
items.condition: combination product applicant, unless equivalent report already submitted

items.statement: If the combination product or device constituent part received marketing authorization under a device application, comply with the device postmarketing safety reporting requirements (medical device reporting and reports of corrections and removals) for the product.
items.quote: If your combination product or device constituent part received marketing authorization under a device application, you must comply with the requirements for postmarketing safety reporting described in parts 803 and 806 of this chapter with respect to your product.
items.condition: authorized under a device application

items.statement: If the combination product or drug constituent part received marketing authorization under an NDA or ANDA, comply with the drug postmarketing safety reporting requirements for the product.
items.quote: If your combination product or drug constituent part received marketing authorization under an NDA or ANDA, you must comply with the requirements for postmarketing safety reporting described in part 314 of this chapter with respect to your product.
items.condition: authorized under an NDA or ANDA

items.statement: If the combination product or biological product constituent part received marketing authorization under a BLA, comply with the biological product postmarketing safety reporting requirements (biologics and blood and blood component requirements) for the product.
items.quote: If your combination product or biological product constituent part received marketing authorization under a BLA, you must comply with the requirements for postmarketing safety reporting described in parts 600 and 606 of this chapter with respect to your product.
items.condition: authorized under a BLA

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, in addition to the general reporting requirements, comply with the additional reporting requirements that apply to the product based on its constituent parts (device, drug, biological product).
items.quote: If you are a combination product applicant, in addition to compliance with paragraph (a) of this section, you must also comply with the reporting requirements identified under this paragraph as applicable to your product based on its constituent parts.
items.condition: combination product applicant

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, submit the constituent-part-based report unless a report for the same event has already been submitted under the application-type-based requirements that contains the required information, is required to be submitted in the same manner, and, unless otherwise specified, meets the applicable deadlines.
items.quote: If you are a combination product applicant, you are required to submit a report as specified in this paragraph unless you have already submitted a report in accordance with paragraph (b) of this section for the same event that: Includes the information required under the applicable regulations for the report identified in this paragraph; is required to be submitted in the same manner under § 4.104 of this chapter; and, unless otherwise specified in this paragraph, meets the deadlines under the applicable regulations for the report identified in this paragraph.
items.condition: combination product applicant, unless equivalent report already submitted

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a device constituent part, submit five-day reports.
items.quote: Five-day reports
items.condition: combination product contains a device constituent part

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a device constituent part, submit malfunction reports.
items.quote: Malfunction reports
items.condition: combination product contains a device constituent part

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a device constituent part, submit correction or removal reports.
items.quote: Correction or removal reports
items.condition: combination product contains a device constituent part

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a device constituent part, maintain records of corrections and removals that are not required to be reported, as described in the device corrections and removals rules.
items.quote: maintain records as described in § 806.20 of this chapter for corrections and removals not required to be reported.
items.condition: device constituent part; corrections and removals not required to be reported

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a drug constituent part, submit field alert reports.
items.quote: Field alert reports
items.condition: combination product contains a drug constituent part

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a drug constituent part, submit drug fifteen-day reports; submit them within 30 calendar days instead of 15 calendar days if the combination product received marketing authorization under a device application.
items.quote: Fifteen-day reports as described in § 314.80 of this chapter, which must be submitted within 30 calendar days instead of 15 calendar days if your combination product received marketing authorization under a device application.
items.condition: drug constituent part; 30 days if authorized under a device application

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a biological product constituent part, submit biological product deviation reports.
items.quote: Biological product deviation reports
items.condition: combination product contains a biological product constituent part

items.statement: If you are a combination product applicant and the combination product contains a biological product constituent part, submit biological product fifteen-day reports; submit them within 30 calendar days instead of 15 calendar days if the combination product received marketing authorization under a device application.
items.quote: Fifteen-day reports as described in § 600.80 of this chapter, which must be submitted within 30 calendar days instead of 15 calendar days if your combination product received marketing authorization under a device application.
items.condition: biological constituent part; 30 days if authorized under a device application

items.statement: If you are the combination product applicant for a product containing a device constituent part that was authorized under an NDA, ANDA or BLA, include in periodic safety reports, in addition to the otherwise required information, a summary and analysis of the five-day reports and malfunction reports submitted during the report interval.
items.quote: If you are the combination product applicant for a combination product that contains a device constituent part and that received marketing authorization under an NDA, ANDA, or BLA, in addition to the information otherwise required in the periodic safety reports you submit under § 314.80 or § 600.80 of this chapter, your periodic safety reports must also include a summary and analysis of the reports identified in paragraphs (c)(1)(i) and (ii) of this section that were submitted during the report interval.
items.condition: device constituent part; authorized under NDA, ANDA or BLA

items.statement: If you are the combination product applicant for a product authorized under a device application, in addition to the required application-type and constituent-part reports, submit reports on postmarketing safety events when notified in writing by the Agency that it requires additional information.
items.quote: If you are the combination product applicant for a combination product that received marketing authorization under a device application, in addition to the reports required under paragraphs (b) and (c) of this section, you must submit reports regarding postmarketing safety events if notified by the Agency in writing that the Agency requires additional information.
items.condition: authorized under a device application; notified in writing by the Agency

items.statement: When you receive information about an event involving a death or serious injury, or an adverse experience, associated with use of the combination product, provide it to the other constituent part applicant(s) for the combination product no later than 5 calendar days after receipt.
items.quote: When you receive information regarding an event that involves a death or serious injury as described in § 803.3 of this chapter, or an adverse experience as described in § 314.80(a) of this chapter or § 600.80(a) of this chapter, associated with the use of the combination product, you must provide the information to the other constituent part applicant(s) for the combination product no later than 5 calendar days of your receipt of the information.
items.condition: information received on death, serious injury or adverse experience

items.statement: Maintain records of the information you must provide to the other constituent part applicant(s) for the combination product.
items.quote: With regard to information you must provide to the other constituent part applicant(s) for the combination product, you must maintain records that include:

items.statement: In the records of information that must be provided to other constituent part applicant(s), keep a copy of the information provided.
items.quote: A copy of the information you provided,

items.statement: In the records of information that must be provided to other constituent part applicant(s), record the date you received the information.
items.quote: The date the information was received by you,

items.statement: In the records of information that must be provided to other constituent part applicant(s), record the date the information was provided to the other constituent part applicant(s).
items.quote: The date the information was provided to the other constituent part applicant(s), and

items.statement: In the records of information that must be provided to other constituent part applicant(s), record the name and address of each other constituent part applicant to whom the information was provided.
items.quote: The name and address of the other constituent part applicant(s) to whom you provided the information.

items.statement: As a constituent part applicant, submit postmarketing safety reports as required by the safety reporting regulations that apply to the product based on its application type (device application, NDA or ANDA, or BLA).
items.quote: If you are a constituent part applicant, you must submit postmarketing safety reports in accordance with the regulations identified in § 4.102(b) that are applicable to your product based on its application type.
items.condition: constituent part applicant

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, submit the required postmarketing safety reports in the manner specified in the regulation that applies to each type of report, except as noted for five-day, malfunction and fifteen-day reports.
items.quote: If you are a combination product applicant, you must submit postmarketing safety reports required under § 4.102 in the manner specified in the regulation applicable to the type of report, with the following exceptions:
items.condition: combination product applicant

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, submit five-day reports and malfunction reports in the manner specified for drug postmarketing safety reports if the product was authorized under an NDA or ANDA, or in the manner specified for biological product postmarketing safety reports if authorized under a BLA.
items.quote: You must submit the postmarketing safety reports identified in § 4.102(c)(1)(i) and (ii) in accordance with § 314.80(g) of this chapter if your combination product received marketing authorization under an NDA or ANDA or in accordance with § 600.80(h) of this chapter if your combination product received marketing authorization under a BLA.
items.condition: combination product applicant; authorized under NDA, ANDA or BLA

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, submit drug and biological product fifteen-day reports in the manner specified for medical device reports if the combination product was authorized under a device application.
items.quote: You must submit the postmarketing safety reports identified in § 4.102(c)(2)(ii) and (c)(3)(ii) in accordance with § 803.12(a) of this chapter if your combination product received marketing authorization under a device application.
items.condition: combination product applicant; authorized under a device application

items.statement: As a constituent part applicant, maintain records according to the recordkeeping requirements of the postmarketing safety reporting regulation(s) that apply to the product based on its application type.
items.quote: You must maintain records in accordance with the recordkeeping requirements in the applicable regulation(s) described in § 4.102(b).
items.condition: constituent part applicant

items.statement: As a constituent part applicant, keep the records of information shared with other constituent part applicants for the longest retention period required under the postmarketing safety reporting regulations that apply to the product.
items.quote: You must maintain records required under § 4.103(b) for the longest time period required for records under the postmarketing safety reporting regulations applicable to your product under § 4.102(b).
items.condition: constituent part applicant

items.statement: As a combination product applicant, keep postmarketing safety reporting records for the longest retention period required under the regulations that apply to the product.
items.quote: If you are a combination product applicant, you must maintain records in accordance with the longest time period required for records under the regulations applicable to your product under § 4.102.
items.condition: combination product applicant
